holds.rationale: Microsoft.Testing.Extensions.Telemetry 2.4.0 selects this major; independently overriding its telemetry implementation is outside the supported MTP graph.
Hedgehog 2.0.4 selects TypeShape 9; forcing an untested transitive major beneath the current property-test library is not a safe upgrade.

jsdom 30.1.0 resolves whatwg-url 17.1.1, whose declared npm attestation URL returns 404; ClaimCore's required npm signature verification therefore fails before it can verify the locked graph. jsdom 30.0.1 resolves the attested 17.1.0 record.
